purpose: This table provides a cleaned record of individual NYC-area flight departures and arrivals for 2013, covering scheduling, delay, and routing fields, intended to feed downstream analytics on carrier punctuality, route volume, and delay patterns.
usage: Consumers should treat dep_time, sched_dep_time, dep_delay, arr_time, sched_arr_time, arr_delay, air_time, and tailnum as nullable and filter or branch logic accordingly when a flight was cancelled or diverted; time_hour is a UTC timestamp and hour/minute are the scheduled departure's local hour/minute components, not independently authoritative times.
limitations: Roughly 2.9% to 3.3% of rows lack dep_time, arr_time, dep_delay, arr_delay, and air_time, most plausibly cancelled flights, and this cleanup neither imputes nor removes those rows; tailnum is missing for about 0.9% of rows and is retained as-is; no exact-duplicate rows were found (duplicate_row_rate 0.0) so no dedupe logic was applied, and the declared grain has not been measured against the warehouse for actual uniqueness.
